title: 17977 - 17977/P1569/005481
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Engine Control Module (ECM) faulty/incomplete
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Engine Control Module (ECM)

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Cruise Control Switch (E45)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
technicalNotes:
If the Cruise Control System (CCS) was retrofitted, check the Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri to the Engine Control Module (ECM). Depending on the Make, Model and Model Year the Hardware Signal can originate from one of the following Sources:
Cruise Control Switch (E45)
Steering Column Control Module (J527)
Central Electronics / Body Control Module (J519)
